title: Daily brief
idea: Daily brief: One dated priority leads a short chronological agenda
audience: People who need to plan day within a mobile surface.
worksWellWhen: A handful of important tasks guides the day
avoidWhen: Users need a complete multi-project ledger
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic editorial layout through its plan day priority and explicit commitment contract: Completion is undoable and never implied by viewing
navigation: Daily brief keeps the current plan day context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: One dated priority leads a short chronological agenda
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to plan day; a handful of important tasks guides the day
composition.priority: Completion is undoable and never implied by viewing

imagery.role: Support the actual plan day context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Collapse secondary agenda rows before compressing the main priority
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the daily brief structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no plan day content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Completion is undoable and never implied by viewing
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized plan day content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Completion is undoable and never implied by viewing
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active plan day context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
